requested_by: Gavin Holt, Change Advisory Board Chair
title: Pre-review six change requests before Thursday's change board meeting
situation: Six change requests are on the agenda, from a routine monthly patch to an emergency fix for the xz/liblzma backdoor on the sign-in service. Some would break older systems that still depend on them, one requester approved their own change, and one is scheduled on a change-freeze date. The board wants a clear decision and a tested backout plan for each.
your_task: Check each request's maintenance window, approvals, test results and backout plan.
Map the blast radius: which other systems go down or break if this change goes ahead.
Rehearse each change with a failure partway through and confirm the backout returns the system to its starting state.
Record APPROVE, APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS or REJECT for each, with the blockers or conditions.
why_it_matters: Most outages are caused by our own changes, not by attackers. A change with no working backout plan can take payroll or the website down for hours.
done_when: 1 request is approved, 2 are approved with conditions and 3 are rejected, each with its reasons.
The port 1521 change is rejected with all 6 blockers, including the self-approval.
The SMBv1 change is rejected because its backout rehearsal failed to restore the server.
A backout runbook exists for the payroll migration and the emergency patch.

glossary.Request for change (RFC): A formal request to change a system, reviewed before anyone makes the change.
glossary.Change Advisory Board (CAB): The group that reviews and approves changes.
glossary.Emergency change board (ECAB): A smaller group that can approve urgent changes quickly, with a review afterward.
glossary.Blast radius: Everything else that could be affected if this change goes wrong.
glossary.Backout plan: The steps to undo a change and return to the way things were.
glossary.Maintenance window: An agreed time slot when planned downtime is allowed.
glossary.Fail forward: Fixing a problem by pushing a new fix, used when a change cannot simply be undone.

talking_point: Pre-reviewed 6 change requests for the change board (1 approved, 2 approved with conditions, 3 rejected), catching a self-approved change, a change-freeze conflict and a backout plan that failed rehearsal.
